summary: A plant's watered-ness as a decaying number, with no growth or visual behaviour attached.
overview: Tracks how watered something is and decays it over time. Deliberately nothing else — what the game does with the number, whether that is swapping a mesh, tinting a colour or killing the plant, is left to whatever listens, so this stays usable in a farming sim, a puzzle or a toy.
useCases: A farming or gardening loop where plants need repeat watering.
Any resource that drains and must be topped up.
Driving a visual state from a normalised 0-1 value.

params.tuning: What makes watering a repeated activity rather than a one-off. Zero turns it into a switch.
A fraction of max, so it stays meaningful when you change maxWater.

gotchas.title: You have to tick it
gotchas.body: Decay happens in Tick, which something else must call. It does not run itself.
